events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Phoenix, Arizona, to Wesley Linden and Willadene Frederickson.

evidence.quote: born August 7 , 1955
Diane Downs was born in Phoenix , Arizona , on August 7 , 1955

events.text: Married Steve Downs after running away from home.

evidence.quote: On November 13 , 1973 , Diane married Steve Downs after running away from home

evidence.quote: Their first child , Christie Ann , was born in 1974

events.text: Divorced Steve Downs, who suspected an affair.

events.text: Gave birth to a daughter through surrogacy and gave the child to her intended parents

events.label: crime
events.text: Shot her three children and drove them to McKenzie-Willamette Hospital.

evidence.quote: On May 19 , 1983 , Downs shot her three children

events.text: Gave birth to Amy Elizabeth about a month after her trial; the child was later seized and adopted

evidence.quote: gave birth to a girl , whom she named Amy Elizabeth , a month after her 1984 trial

events.label: arrest
events.text: Arrested and charged with murder and attempted murder.

evidence.quote: Downs was arrested on February 28 , 1984

events.label: conviction
events.text: Convicted on all charges and sentenced to life plus 50 years.

evidence.quote: Downs was convicted on all charges on June 17 , 1984
She was convicted in 1984 and sentenced to life in prison plus fifty years

events.text: Fred Hugi and his wife adopted her two surviving children

evidence.quote: He and his wife Joanne adopted them in 1986

events.label: escape
events.text: Briefly escaped custody and was recaptured.

evidence.quote: Downs briefly escaped in 1987 and was recaptured

events.label: book
events.text: Ann Rule published the book Small Sacrifices about Downs

evidence.quote: Author Ann Rule wrote the book Small Sacrifices ( 1987 ) detailing Downs life and murder trial

events.label: escape
events.text: Escaped from her cell in Oregon by scaling a razor wire fence.

evidence.quote: She escaped from her cell in Oregon on July 11 , 1988 by scaling an 18-foot razor wire fence

events.label: recapture
events.text: Recaptured after about ten days at large, during a 14-state manhunt.

evidence.quote: She escaped from her cell in Oregon on July 11 , 1988
For ten days Downs managed to escape despite a 14-state manhunt before she was recaptured
